rules.statement: The provider is accredited and the accreditor is named

basis.citation: Accredited continuing education is offered by a provider accredited by ACCME, a state medical society recognised by ACCME, Joint Accreditation, or the equivalent body for the profession or country.

parameters.label: Separation of marketing from accredited education (minutes before and after)
parameters.source: ACCME Standard 5 per research report (UCF CPD policy restating it). Not read in primary text.

clauses.label: Provider control of funds and content
clauses.text: The Provider makes all decisions about the receipt and disbursement of this support and about content, faculty, learners and methods. Halden Pharma will not pay directly for any expense of the education, of faculty or of learners.

clauses.label: No learner expenses
clauses.text: No part of the support will be used to pay for the travel, lodging, registration, honoraria or personal expenses of individual learners.

clauses.label: Accounting on request
clauses.text: The Provider will keep a record of the amount or kind of support received and how it was used, and will provide that accounting to Halden Pharma on request.

clauses.label: Disclosure to learners
clauses.text: Before the activity the Provider will tell learners the name of Halden Pharma as a source of support and the nature of any in-kind support, without corporate or product logos, trade names or messages.

clauses.label: Parties
clauses.text: This agreement is between Halden Pharma and the accredited Provider. A joint provider or educational partner may be named but does not sign in the Provider's place.

notes: accme.org was blocked. Standard 4 content follows the research report and a web-search summary; item numbering (4.1–4.4, 5.1–5.3) is not used in rule refs because it could not be confirmed.

The same Standards apply to ANCC, ACPE, Joint Accreditation and, from June 2026, ADA CERP per the research report. For UK and France the pack is used with the national accreditor named in provider.accreditor (e.g. Federation of the Royal Colleges of Physicians CPD approval; ANDPC for DPC). Whether those bodies impose identical terms has not been verified.
